meta.title: GAIA LEARNING PREMIUM
meta.description: Anime-led video training for companies in Japan.

home.heroTitle: Learn the job through stories, not manuals.
home.heroLead: Short training videos on business manners, workplace safety, Japanese and IT, told by GAIA's eight characters. Available to international staff in seven languages.
home.heroNote: From ¥30,000 a month (tax incl.) for one account
home.introTitle: Training that reaches the people doing the work.
home.introBody: No time to read manuals. Language gets in the way. GAIA LEARNING turns each topic into a 5–15 minute anime story that works on a phone during a break. Managers can see who has learned what at a glance.

features.title: Stories you remember
features.body: Eight characters act out everyday workplace moments, so staff remember the situation, not a rule list.

features.title: Seven languages
features.body: Menus and subtitles in Japanese, Vietnamese, English, Burmese, Indonesian, Sinhala and Khmer.

features.title: A record for every employee
features.body: Each employee gets their own account. See viewing history and completion in one place.

features.title: Protected streaming
features.body: Only accounts with an active subscription can play videos, and the server checks access on every request.

home.pricingLead: The same price for individuals and companies. To add employees, just add the per-account price.
home.planMonthlyDesc: Start with one month. Cancel anytime and keep access until the period ends.
home.planAnnualDesc: Twelve months for the price of ten, paid once a year.
home.planEnterpriseDesc: For 50+ accounts, invoice billing or custom training categories, let's talk.
home.footerAbout: GAIA LEARNING is video training for everyone working in Japan.

admin.title: Admin center
admin.subtitle: See how the business is doing and update the site.
admin.pendingBody: Check the deposit in your bank account first, then press Confirm payment. The subscription activates immediately and the receipt is emailed.
admin.approved: Payment {code} confirmed. Subscription activated and receipt sent (demo)
admin.contentBody: Changes save as a draft first. Check the preview, then publish.
admin.publishedToast: Published (demo — production saves to the database)
admin.adminsBody: Enter an email and choose a role. Someone not registered yet becomes an admin as soon as they sign up with that email. Admins always sign in with 2-step verification.
admin.adminPending: {email} becomes an admin when they sign up.
admin.liveKpiNote: Registered users and companies are live. Other figures and charts stay demo until Phases 3–4.
admin.errForbidden: Only a Super admin can do this.
admin.errSelf: You can't change your own access.
admin.errGeneric: That didn't work. Try again in a few minutes.
admin.needsServiceRole: Admin tools need SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to be set.
admin.pendingSignup: Not signed up yet (applies on sign-up)
admin.seatsBelowUsed: Can't go below the {used} people already using seats.
admin.seatsHelp: A company starts with 1 account for its manager (¥30,000/month). After payment for extra accounts (¥3,000 per person/month) is confirmed, raise the number here. From Phase 4 card payments add them automatically.
admin.planActivated: Plan activated and the payment recorded.
admin.videoType: Choose an MP4, WebM or MOV file.
admin.videoSize: Files can be up to 50 MB (free plan limit).
admin.videoUploadFailed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
admin.videoAddBody: Files upload straight to private storage; only members with an active plan get a playback link.
admin.videoPublished: Published. It now appears in the library.
admin.thumbHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Landscape (16:9) works best. If you skip it, a frame from the video is used.
admin.imageType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
admin.imageSize: Images can be up to 5 MB.
admin.pendingBodyLive: Check that a deposit matching the order number and amount has arrived, then press Confirm payment. The plan activates immediately and a receipt number is issued.
admin.billingSettingsBody: The bank account is shown at checkout; the issuer details are printed on receipts.
admin.invoiceRegNoInvalid: Use T followed by 13 digits (e.g. T1234567890123).
admin.textLanguageHint: Text is entered per language. Empty languages show the built-in text.
admin.pricesSuperOnly: Only a Super admin can change prices.
admin.previewHint: Preview shows the saved draft. Save the draft first after making changes.
admin.cmsLogoHint: A PNG with a transparent background works best. Shown in the menu, footer and sign-in pages.
admin.cmsEmptyHint: Leave a field empty to use the built-in text shown faintly inside it.
admin.cmsPricesHint: Publishing updates the homepage pricing and the amounts for new orders and renewals. Running card plans keep their price.

auth.signupLead: Individuals and companies pay the same price. We'll email you a confirmation link.
auth.checkEmailBody: Open the link we sent to {email} to finish signing up. If it isn't there, check your spam folder.
auth.forgotLead: We'll email a reset link to your registered address.
auth.resetSent: If this email is registered, a reset link is on its way.
auth.setPasswordLead: Enter a new password. If you were invited, this is where you set your first one.
auth.mfaWhy: The admin center handles revenue and member data, so it needs a code as well as your password.
auth.mfaEnrollLead: You only set this up once.
auth.mfaStep1: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator or similar).
auth.mfaSecret: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
auth.mfaStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
auth.mfaChallengeLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.notAdmin: This account does not have access to the admin center.
